% Pattern: head/case. Case and step heads after a space in math, as
% "$\qquad$ {\bf Step 1:}", with the number of a count, as "Case 1/2", in
% bold math, as "$\mathbf{Case \ 2}.$", and with a number word, as "Step
% one:", which is not a number. Inside a paragraph, a case head with no colon
% or period after it is a word of the sentence. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want head-1 other/case 1
% want head-2 other/case 1/2
% want head-3 other/case 2
% want head-4 other/case -
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}
\begin{proof} We take a cover of the space by balls.

$\qquad$ {\bf Step 1:} Take a finite subcover.

\textbf{Case 1/2.} The subcover is empty. Then the space is empty.

$\mathbf{Case \ 2}.$ The subcover is not empty.

\textit{Step one: the radius.} Take the largest radius, and go to the
{\it Final step} with this radius.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
